list.name: Changes
list.comment: Create solveSchedule() and showInformation() to clean the rest of the code, the solver and show information part

task.summary: Add tasks MinutesOfTheWeek() calculates the minutes of that time from the beginning of Monday OverlapTasks verifies if there is an overlap in the schedule of two tasks This tasks are not CSP variables because they are fixed values, but are used in the restriction to avoid overlaps The time is seen as a readable string and as a int to calculate the overlaps

Initialize the CSP model and solver All tasks that are fixed are considered interval var because they have a specific begin, duration and end All optional tasks (in this case Gym) have a domain of possible intervals that can take, it's the solver job to find a opening to fill, this "optional" will be set according to a bool_var that defines if the task exists The solver doesn't have still an objective, so the solution it gives is the one where it doesn't put gym anywhere
Adding weights to optimal tasks so that the solver prioritizes a tasks with higher priorities
Fixing bug where there was not any fixed tasks and giving a valid interval for optimal tasks
Adding a new optional task with variable duration, add restriction to verify start + duration = end but the model chooses the minimum time possible

Creating a new optional task of variable duration which is "Study in the Library", serves to see if multiple variables what is the parameters of the variable In this example, the library has a 9h to 16h schedule, but I don't want to be there before 10h, so the start domain is [10h, 16h]
Create function createNewOptionalTask() to create a new Optional Task and a dict that stores all information of every task
Creating a data Structure with all optional tasks and simplify the signature of the createNewOptionalTask() function
Create solveSchedule() and showInformation() to clean the rest of the code, the solver and show information part
